subject: Mobile Development
title: Fragmentation: Android's Achilles Heel
description: A quick, practical guide to Fragmentation: Android's Achilles Heel.

hook.text: Android runs on thousands of different devices with different screen sizes and chip speeds.

buildup.text: Each manufacturer customizes Android, adding skins, bloatware, and delayed updates.

discovery.text: Developers must test on dozens of devices. A bug on one phone might not exist on another.

twist.text: Many Android phones stop receiving security updates after just two years.

climax.text: Fragmentation is the cost of openness. More choice means less consistency.

punchline.text: Openness won market share but lost consistency.

quiz.question: What is Android fragmentation?
options: Many different devices, versions, and customizations
